name: doordash
strip_regex: <tr[^>]*>(?:(?!</tr>).)*?(?:You are receiving this|Unsubscribe|Download the app|App Store|Google Play|facebook\.com|twitter\.com|instagram\.com)(?:(?!</tr>).)*?</tr>
notes: Removed from a DoorDash order receipt: the track order button, the marketing hero image row, and the footer row that carries the app download links, the social links and the unsubscribe link. Kept verbatim: every item line, the subtotal, fees, tax and tip lines, the order total, the store name, the order date and the payment line.
